description: Schema to extract all available product models from a PDF and capture accurate model-level metadata. Missing values must be coded as NULL. Dimensional data must be separated based on source (table vs diagram).

fields.name: manufacturer_name
fields.instruction: Extract the official manufacturer name from the document. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: model_number
fields.instruction: Extract all model numbers explicitly listed in the PDF. Do not infer or generate model numbers. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: product_description
fields.instruction: Extract the product description from the first page of the PDF. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: product_line
fields.instruction: Extract the product line or series name explicitly mentioned in the document. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: product_literature_year
fields.instruction: Extract the year of publication from the document metadata or visible document date. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: product_literature_id
fields.instruction: Extract the document ID, bulletin number, or literature reference number if explicitly stated. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: shipping_weight
fields.instruction: Extract shipping or crated weight for the model from tables only. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: installed_weight
fields.instruction: Extract installed, operating, or net weight of the model from tables only. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: length
fields.instruction: Extract overall length from product diagrams only. Do not use specification tables for this field. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: width
fields.instruction: Extract overall width from product diagrams only. Do not use specification tables for this field. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: height
fields.instruction: Extract overall height from product diagrams only. Do not use specification tables for this field. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: diameter
fields.instruction: Extract diameter from product diagrams for cylindrical products only. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: length_table
fields.instruction: Extract length from specification tables only. Do not use diagram dimensions for this field. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: width_table
fields.instruction: Extract width from specification tables only. Do not use diagram dimensions for this field. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: height_table
fields.instruction: Extract height from specification tables only. Do not use diagram dimensions for this field. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: diameter_table
fields.instruction: Extract diameter from specification tables only. Do not use diagram dimensions for this field. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: minimum_circuit_amps_mca
fields.instruction: Extract minimum circuit amps or MCA from electrical specification tables only. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: maximum_overcurrent_protection_mop
fields.instruction: Extract maximum over-current protection value such as MOP or MOCP from electrical specification tables only. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: power_supply_configuration
fields.instruction: Extract electrical power supply configuration such as volts, hertz, and phase from electrical specifications. If not available, return NULL.
